description: Defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) used for authentication and user management API requests and responses, including login, registration, and role assignment.

classes.name: AuthDtos.LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for login request containing user email and password.

classes.name: AuthDtos.LoginResponse
classes.description: DTO for login response containing JWT token, user email, and roles.

classes.name: AuthDtos.RegisterRequest
classes.description: DTO for user registration request containing full name, email, password, and roles.

classes.name: AuthDtos.AssignRolesRequest
classes.description: DTO for assigning roles to a user.

methods.name: AuthDtos.LoginResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing token, email, and roles fields.
